title: silybum mariae
intro: Silybum mariae, commonly known as Milk Thistle, is a flowering plant in the daisy family, native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used for centuries in traditional medicine to treat liver and gallbladder disorders, and its health benefits include the protection of liver cells from damage, improvement of liver function, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Silybum mariae include hepatoprotective, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which help to reduce liver damage and improve overall health. The bioactive constituents of Silybum mariae include flavonolignans, particularly silymarin, which is a mixture of isomers including silibinin, silidianin, and silicristin, responsible for its medicinal properties.
